evidence.reason: Classification: login-free-upload-only. `edgeone makers deploy --anonymous` succeeded with no account and printed an access URL, a project id, a claim command and a 60-minute claim deadline, but every read of that URL returned 401 from a platform page that tells the visitor to obtain a link from the owner and the owner to mint one in the console. A controlled matrix (60 reads at 0/2/5/15/30/60s, both sites, with and without the query token, plain and browser-like headers) never returned 200; after the claim window the same URLs returned 404 because the unclaimed project is removed. Nothing was ever served.

notes: A second independent network was not available for this candidate; the verdict is conservative for that reason as well. Raw reads: research/edgeone-anonymous-measurement-2026-09-13.json.
